changelog:
v2.9.9 - Screen Recorder FIXED (root cause found)

- BUG FIX: after accepting the recording popup the app showed NOTHING - the recording indicator was invisible to the UI (plain var, not Compose state). The screen now flips to the LIVE REC panel instantly.
- Toast feedback: 'REC started' when recording begins, 'Saved: filename' when it stops.
- Pause/Resume state updates the UI live.
- Includes v2.9.8 Split Screen Launcher.
